Terrible Service - Rude Staff
Jan 2026 • Couples
My girlfriend and I visited this place hoping for a decent experience, and instead we were met with some of the worst service I’ve ever encountered.

First off, the female staff member completely ignored us while we stood there waiting to be seated. No greeting, no acknowledgment—just acted like we didn’t exist. When we finally managed to get her attention, she didn’t even bother saying hello. Instead, she immediately assumed we wanted beer, as if that’s all customers are good for, without asking a single question about what we actually needed.

It somehow got worse from there. When she finally directed us to our seat, she addressed me as “hey.” Not “sir,” not “you guys,” not even a basic “follow me”—just “hey.” It was incredibly unprofessional and disrespectful.

Her overall demeanor was crude and rude. She was short, stocky, with a round face, and while I didn’t catch her name, her attitude made her unforgettable for all the wrong reasons. There was zero courtesy, zero hospitality, and zero effort to make us feel welcome.

My girlfriend and I left feeling annoyed and disrespected. If this is the kind of service this place thinks is acceptable, I won’t be coming back—and I wouldn’t recommend it to anyone who expects basic manners and professionalism.

Services and ambiance need improvement
Jun 2019 • Family
Today June 1st, 2019, we came to have lunch. We understood that the restaurant was busy but staffs should be able to spend at least some attention to guests. The staffs barely made eye contacts which was why it was difficult to catch their attention. 

Moreover, the music was loud. There was already noisy music just outside the restaurant because of an event. Such music from the event was enough to fill the entire Estella. It made no sense to turn the music in the restaurant even louder to compete with the outside noise.

Regarding the ambiance, I must say that the lightings within the restaurant made me so uncomfortable. There was enough natural light for the entire restaurant that there was no need to turn on all the warm yellow light bulbs. It was noon time, the heat and the excessive light exposure were unnecessary. It was a waste of electricity.

When I made a request to turn off the light bulb as it was too hot, the first staff just ignored. Even if such request cant be met, at least an answer should be given as an act of courtesy.

In the end I was in no mood to eat that I decide to take away the pizza. 

This is not the first time this place made me feel so disappointed. The first time I came, I was in front waiting for a table and the staff did not even bother to tell me they were fully booked. Only after 10 minutes of intense gazing that she decided to let me know the situation.

I guess most people are just so easy with what they receive vs what they are buying. I am writing this review to help people who value good services to think twice before entering this place.

Have a great time dining everyone.
